strings.cupMismatch.2.body: Boss, {opponent} are two divisions above us. On paper, we are expected to lose by a couple. Keep it tight, and this can still become the funny kind of Cup story.
strings.cupMismatch.2.star: One more thing: {player} is their likeliest scorer. Give them less room than a budget-airline seat.
strings.cupMismatch.2.title: Two divisions above us
strings.cupMismatch.3.body: Boss, {opponent} are three divisions above us. A three or four-goal defeat would not shock the statisticians. Their substitutes probably have substitutes.
strings.cupMismatch.3.star: {player} is their main goal threat. If they look unmarked, that is not a tactical shape. That is an emergency.
strings.cupMismatch.3.title: Three divisions. Oh dear.
strings.cupMismatch.4.body: Boss, {opponent} are four divisions above us — the full pyramid. We are expected to lose by the kind of score normally counted with both hands. If they stop at four, I may send a thank-you card.
strings.cupMismatch.4.star: {player} is their likeliest scorer. I would say double-mark them, but I do not want the other ten to feel ignored.
strings.cupMismatch.4.title: Four divisions. I checked twice.
strings.cupUpset.1.body: Boss, that was magnificent! We've just sent a club from the division above packing. That's a proper Cup upset. Enjoy this one.
strings.cupUpset.1.title: You've toppled a favourite
strings.cupUpset.2.body: Boss. Two divisions. TWO. Clubs like ours are not supposed to get past sides like that, and we just did it in front of everyone.
strings.cupUpset.2.title: Two divisions up!
strings.cupUpset.3.body: Boss, I have run out of professional composure. Three divisions above us. Three! They will be talking about this one in the town for years.
strings.cupUpset.3.title: THREE DIVISIONS!
strings.cupUpset.4.body: BOSS. Four divisions. The whole way up the pyramid, in one afternoon. Nobody does this. I have watched football my entire life and I have never, never seen anything like it.
strings.cupUpset.4.title: GIANT-KILLERS!
strings.endgameCelebration.cupWinners.divisionSt: The division is still the goal. Win D1 and the climb is complete.
strings.endgameCelebration.cupWinners.everyRound: Every round a single tie, every tie a single chance. You took all of them.
strings.endgameCelebration.cupWinners.headline: HERO CUP WINNERS
strings.endgameCelebration.globalLeague.climbedE: {star} climbed every rung of it with you.
strings.endgameCelebration.globalLeague.headline: GLOBAL LEAGUE CHAMPIONS
strings.endgameCelebration.globalLeague.noDivisi: There is no division above this one. The ladder is finished.
strings.endgameCelebration.globalLeague.oneTroph: One trophy is still out there. Win the Hero Cup and the climb is complete.
strings.endgameCelebration.signoff.keepAnEyeOut: People like you are what let him make the next one. Keep an eye out for it.
strings.endgameCelebration.signoff.madeByOneMan: One last thing. This game was made by one man on his own, Joe Vu, and he thanks you very much.
strings.endgameCelebration.trueEnding.beforeAnyo: Boss. Before anyone else gets in here, thank you.
strings.endgameCelebration.trueEnding.headline: THE CLIMB IS COMPLETE
strings.endgameCelebration.trueEnding.notTheTrop: But it is not the trophies I will carry. It is the mornings on the training pitch, and the one man who kept turning up for me.
strings.endgameCelebration.trueEnding.weWonBoth: We won the league. We won the Cup. I am glad we did.
strings.endgameCelebration.trueEnding.whereverTh: Wherever this goes next, I got here with you. Thank you, boss.
strings.endgameCelebration.trueEnding.youMadeMe: You made me the player I am. Every bit of it came out of your coaching.

strings.playerArrival.youth.aScoutCalledMeUnteac: A scout called me unteachable. I heard 'finished product'.
strings.playerArrival.youth.canIGetAPhoto: Can I get a photo before you change your mind?
strings.playerArrival.youth.doICallYouBoss: Do I call you boss, or...? Right. Boss it is.
strings.playerArrival.youth.dontWorryGaffer: Don't worry, gaffer. I'll go easy on the first team.
strings.playerArrival.youth.firstProperBoots: First proper boots! Size too big, but I'll grow into them.
strings.playerArrival.youth.giveMeAMatch: Give me a match. I'll explain the rest.
strings.playerArrival.youth.honestlyIThoughtThis: Honestly? I thought this was just the stadium tour.
strings.playerArrival.youth.iBroughtMyOwnPen: I brought my own pen. In case of contracts.
strings.playerArrival.youth.iCountedTheFloodligh: I counted the floodlights on the way in. There are four.
strings.playerArrival.youth.iDontGetNervous: I don't get nervous. Ask me again in ten minutes.
strings.playerArrival.youth.iDreamtThisExactMome: I dreamt this exact moment. There was more rain in mine.
strings.playerArrival.youth.iKeepWaitingForSomeb: I keep waiting for somebody to ask me to leave.
strings.playerArrival.youth.iPromiseNotToBreakAn: I promise not to break anything you've paid for.
strings.playerArrival.youth.iTalkToMyselfOutTher: I talk to myself out there. Ignore about half of it.
strings.playerArrival.youth.iToldTheWholeStreet: I told the whole street I'd signed. That was yesterday.
strings.playerArrival.youth.illRunUntilYouTellMe: I'll run until you tell me to stop. Please tell me to stop.
strings.playerArrival.youth.illTakeThePenalties: I'll take the penalties. Starting whenever you like.
strings.playerArrival.youth.imBetterThanMyHighli: I'm better than my highlight reel. It's mostly one goal.
strings.playerArrival.youth.imNotHereToMakeUpNum: I'm not here to make up numbers.
strings.playerArrival.youth.imQuickerThanILook: I'm quicker than I look. I've had to be.
strings.playerArrival.youth.isThePitchAlwaysThis: Is the pitch always this big, or is it just today?
strings.playerArrival.youth.isThereACanteen: Is there a canteen? Asking for me. All of me.
strings.playerArrival.youth.iveBeenAwakeSinceFou: I've been awake since four. Is that normal for this?
strings.playerArrival.youth.iveBeenReadyForTwoYe: I've been ready for two years. Nobody asked till now.
strings.playerArrival.youth.iveGotAGoodFeeling: I've got a good feeling about this. I get those a lot.
strings.playerArrival.youth.iveLearnedEveryonesN: I've learned everyone's name. Including the physio's dog.
strings.playerArrival.youth.iveNeverSeenThisMany: I've never seen this many footballs in one place.
strings.playerArrival.youth.ivePractisedMyCelebr: I've practised my celebration. In a mirror. For hours.
strings.playerArrival.youth.iveWatchedFromTheSta: I've watched from the stands since I was six. Odd view here.
strings.playerArrival.youth.myLeftFootIsForStand: My left foot is for standing on. I'm working on it.
strings.playerArrival.youth.myMumSaysImTheBest: My mum says I'm the best in the country. She's biased.
strings.playerArrival.youth.nobodyInMyFamilyHasS: Nobody in my family has ever signed anything before.
strings.playerArrival.youth.nobodyTellMeTheWages: Nobody tell me the wages. I'd have come for nothing.
strings.playerArrival.youth.putMeAnywhere: Put me anywhere. I've been in goal before. It was fine.
strings.playerArrival.youth.sameSocksEveryMatch: Same socks every match day. Don't ask me why.
strings.playerArrival.youth.saveMeAShirtNumber: Save me a shirt number. A famous one.
strings.playerArrival.youth.tellMeWhatToFix: Tell me what to fix first. I'll start today.
strings.playerArrival.youth.whereDoIPutMyBag: Where do I put my bag? Sorry. Bag first, football after.
strings.playerArrival.youth.youllWantToRenegotia: You'll want to renegotiate this after Saturday.
strings.playerFarewell.guilt.feeMatteredMore: So that's it? A transfer fee mattered more than I did.
strings.playerFarewell.guilt.gaveEverything: I gave you everything. I hope the money does the same.
strings.playerFarewell.guilt.lookRelieved: Don't look so relieved, boss. I can see you.
strings.playerFarewell.guilt.otherClubToldMe: You could have told me before the other club did.
strings.playerFarewell.guilt.wageBill: I suppose the wage bill will sleep better without me.
strings.playerFarewell.sad.dressingRoom: I'll miss this dressing room more than I expected.
strings.playerFarewell.sad.keptMyShirt: I kept my club shirt. I hope that's all right.
strings.playerFarewell.sad.lastMatch: I wish my last match had gone differently.
strings.playerFarewell.sad.moreTime: I thought I had more time here, boss.
strings.playerFarewell.sad.tellTheLads: Tell the lads I did not want to leave without saying goodbye.
strings.playerFarewell.sentimental.checkResults: Wherever I play next, I will still check your results.
strings.playerFarewell.sentimental.everyMinute: Thank you for every minute I wore this shirt.
strings.playerFarewell.sentimental.family: I came here as a player. I leave with a family.
strings.playerFarewell.sentimental.gaveMeAChance: This club gave me a chance. I will remember that.
strings.playerFarewell.sentimental.saveASeat: No hard feelings, boss. Save me a seat in the stands.

strings.powerEffect.a11y.webTrap: A web snaps around the carrier, spills the ball, and holds the victim in a cocoon for about two seconds.
